title: dedicated: improve autoscaling burst controls and utilization reporting
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: Dedicated customers require predictable throughput during traffic spikes while still keeping long-term fleet efficiency. This PR introduces a new burst control policy and expands utilization reporting to make burst consumption visible in the Console and metrics pipeline. Changes address two gaps: 1) lack of a soft burst budget with automatic replenishment, which caused noisy fallbacks during short spikes; 2) insufficient per-fleet utilization telemetry for proactive capacity planning. Summary of changes: implement a token-bucket style burst budget with configurable refill and max-burst parameters; wire burst consumption metrics through statsd -> metrics-collector -> metrics pipeline; surface burst and sustained-utilization metrics in Console and rollout warnings; add e2e guards to ensure autoscaler respects burst budgets and can fallback gracefully. Checklist: - implement burst budget state machine and eviction safety checks; - add config knobs to Dedicated API and terraform module; - enrich metrics (burst_used, burst_refill_rate, fleet_utilization_1m/5m/1h) and export to Prometheus; - Console: add per-route and per-fleet charts + alert suggestions; - tests: unit coverage for budget state machine, integration test in perf-canary harness, e2e smoke test for policy enforcement. Related: Linear ENG-4521 for autoscaling policy work; SUP-1198 incident investigation that motivated burst visibility. Migration impact: new default burst policy is conservative and can be tuned per-customer; no forced rollouts. Rollout plan: feature-flagged, enable for a subset of Dedicated fleets for 2 weeks, monitor metrics and then global rollout. Documentation: updated Console docs and terraform examples included.
